title: knot-identification-pipeline: knot type of closed space curves from their geometry
description: Identifies the knot type of a closed space curve given as a Fourier series, without consulting knot tables during identification: GPU camera-flight crossing scanner, crossing tracker, diagram resolution, simplification (Regina, spherogram), invariants (SnapPy, SageMath, KnotJob, Bar-Natan–van der Veen Theta), and only afterwards a comparison with KnotInfo, Fremlin and the SnapPy census. Built for the stainless-steel knot sculptures of Werner Alois Stanggassinger (sculptor). Code written by Claude Code (Anthropic), which orchestrates the computations. Every pipeline module was checked against the code behind our published results by comparing abstract syntax trees after the documented changes (translated comments, messages and names; paths moved into one configuration file); the equivalence gates are included; the research tools in research/ list their changes in their own READMEs. Website: https://knot-structures.stainlesssteel4u.de/
